column2: Minor changes brought to JORGE GABITTO

Due to specific PeG game rules (no embark mode for ground transport) scenarios can be won earlier than in PG2. As a result I reduced scenario length (number of turns to get a BV, V or TV) and reinforcement units appear sometimes earlier too.
column3: 由于 PeG 特有的游戏规则（地面运输没有装载模式），场景可能比 PG2 更快取胜。因此我缩短了场景长度（获得 BV、V 或 TV 所需的回合数），补充兵员有时也出现得更早。
